description_en: Adds a custom filter condition to a specified version to extend the query filtering capabilities of the version
description_zh: 给指定版本添加自定义过滤条件，可以通过自定义的方式扩展版本的查询筛选能力
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc create-customized-filter --version-type FOTA --black-white-type BLACK --value 1,2,3 --project-id P0VFCREU --value-compare-type NUMBER --name AnotherFilter --value-type WRITE --version-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCustomizedFilter

parameters.help_en:
The version type. Valid values:

FOTA: system version.
APP: application version
parameters.help_zh:
版本类型。取值：

FOTA：系统版本
APP：应用版本
parameters.name: version_type

parameters.help_en:
The blacklists and whitelists type for comparison. Valid values:

BLACK: blacklist.
WHITE: whitelist
parameters.help_zh:
比较的黑白名单类型：

BLACK：黑名单
WHITE：白名单
parameters.name: black_white_type

parameters.help_en: The value of the filter condition
parameters.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The comparison type for the value. Valid values:

NUMBER: compared as a number.
STRING: compared as a string
parameters.help_zh:
值的比较类型。取值：

NUMBER：按数字比较
STRING：按字符串比较
parameters.name: value_compare_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the filter condition
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The value type of the filter condition.

Currently, only WRITE is supported, which indicates handwriting input
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件值类型。

目前仅支持WRITE，表示手写输入
parameters.name: value_type
